Plot projections of genes/gene pairs in Wpca space

plotWpca.Rd

It's similar to scater::plotPCA, but each point is a gene or gene pair instead of a cell.

Usage

plotWpca(wpca_out, dims = 1:2, color_by = NULL, size = 0.5, label = TRUE)

Arguments

wpca_out

Output of runWpca.

dims

Which PCs to plot, as ingeter indices

color_by

Vector to color the points, must be in the same order as the row names of wpca_out$x

size

Point size

Value

A ggplot2 object. fact_matrix will be used when plotting more than 2 PCs.
